name: org.jboss.aerogear.android.unifiedpush.fcm.AeroGearFCMMessageReceiver
description: The JBoss AeroGear Android Push SDK receives Firebase Cloud Messaging data messages here and forwards their fields to the app's registered push handlers.
disableEffect: If disabled, incoming AeroGear push messages are not passed to the app, so features that rely on those messages stop updating.
